theme: A recreation of a typical home interior in Great Springs Town, based on descriptions from Angelina and her companions. Step inside and take a breath, and the air seems to carry the sweet scent of carrots, along with the faint smell of sulfur from the hot springs.

list:
You received a gift, sent all the way from Rim Billiton, with ice packed inside to keep it cool... a carrot soda?!
The one who sent it carries you leaping above the clouds and soaring into the sky, until the land becomes a lime.
During the Until the Land Becomes a Lime event, obtain the free Operator Timeslot

You were startled by a swarm of little flying bugs she released, before realizing they were just machines.
The engineer standing high above didn't notice the small commotion below, and kept carefully calibrating away. Working at such heights had frightened a few tears out of her, yet she remained utterly resolute.
During the Until the Land Becomes a Lime event, consume 4000 Moments Along the Way in [Traveler's Backpack]

You listened as the girls, their journey over, shared many fun memories.
They told of a sand beast burrowing right through their tent in the middle of the night, of a strange tuskbeast claiming the back seat of their off-roader as its den... You're still sitting in your chair, yet you can almost feel the Rim Billiton wind, with its faint hint of carrot sweetness.
Complete all the content in [Wish List] and collect the rewards

You witnessed every wish along the journey come true.
And in your heart, you wish that they may run faster and farther, forever running on the road ahead.
In [Angelina's Travel Notes], unlock all explorable areas of the 'Dusk Dash'

You toured every area of the 'Dusk Dash'.
This mobile mining platform has been completely transformed, and now billows with hot spring steam. Though dusk has come, it keeps moving forward.
Clear TO-6 with a 3-star rating and make 'Temptation of Gourmet' take a hard fall at least 3 times

You earned yourself a new nickname: 'the Leg Sweeper'.
If it means getting the most delicious carrot ice cream, a little trickery never hurt anyone!
Complete all stages in [Toward the Land's End] with 3-star ratings

You rode with them in a bumpy off-roader all the way to the end of their journey.
The morning sun shines down on you. Those in search of answers have come to this land without a soul in sight. The rising sun says nothing, and the waves say nothing, but the very selves who gave everything to come here for their dreams are the answer to every question.
Complete all stages in [Gazing at the Road Ahead] on Challenge Mode

You never stopped moving forward.
The bags are packed, but the journey has never ended. Where will your next trip with them take you?
Complete all stages in [On the Long Road Home] on Challenge Mode

You completed a journey to remember.
From a destination that carried their dreams to a home full of warmth, all the joys and sorrows along the way have now found a place to rest.
During the Until the Land Becomes a Lime event, deliver a total of 30 Floating Letters

You delivered countless feelings waiting to reach their recipients.
Words that went unspoken, words people wanted to tell each other even from thousands of miles apart—they will reach the hearts of those waiting, and bring them happy smiles.
set: Until the Land Becomes a Lime Engraved Medal Set

A set of engraved medals recording a journey southward across Rim Billiton.
A journey will see you bid farewell to old acquaintances, help you make new friends, and above all, lead you to discover a better, more resolute self. So when the thought of setting out pops into your head, don't hesitate any longer—shoulder your pack and hit the road!
